text:
emily: quick RFC follow-up: i'm building a tiny 'decision matrix' service that picks fp8/int8/4bit per-request. want a quick sanity check.
tomas: nice. high level: matrix inputs?
emily: thinking: {model, route, prompt-fingerprint, seq_len, recent_degradation, calibration_age, user_tier, hw_load}. output: lane + reason + profile_id.
lia: agree on inputs. two constraints: 1) decision at request start only, 2) strict per-request lock (no mid-stream lane swaps).
sam: also need cooldown per-profile-route combo so we don't oscillate on bursty traffic. cooldowns should be in seconds and configurable.
emily: proposal for storage: profiles are immutable JSON objects in config-service with semantic ids. runtime caches them in-process (LRU size ~1024) + subscribe to config change stream for invalidation.
tomas: runtime eval must be cheap. keep matrix as small set of weighted rules rather than full ML. we can expand later.
emily: draft profile schema (short): ```{
  "profile_id": "qmat-2026-03-20-v1",
  "lanes": ["fp8","int8","int4"],
  "rules": [
    {"id":"long_ctx","if":"seq_len>2048","prefer":"fp8","score":0.8},
    {"id":"deg_high","if":"recent_degradation>0.15","prefer":"int8","hysteresis_s":180}
  ],
  "default":"int8",
  "rollout": {"canary_percent":1}
}```
lia: looks fine. ensure 'if' supports simple ops only. avoid complex eval at runtime.
sam: telemetry hooks: tag every request with quant_lane, profile_id, decision_reason, decision_hash, calibration_age. also emit an internal metric for "mirror_delta" when we mirror to safer lane.
emily: mirror plan: sample 0.5-2% of traffic for mirrored execution on safer lane; collect quality delta offline.
tomas: fallback semantics: if post-generation QA (reranker or heuristic) fails, do immediate synchronous retry on safer lane for sync endpoints only. record this as "retry_with_lane" event.
lia: one more safety: if calibration_age > X (e.g., 72h) and sample_count < threshold, bias to safer lane automatically. add an explicit field in profile: min_calib_samples.
emily: operations: profile rollout states: draft -> canary -> ramp -> pinned. default runtime behavior is latest unless pinned per-route. pinned profile id takes precedence.
sam: add rollout limits: max-error-rate, max-retries-per-minute, and emergency-rollover to a global-safe-profile.
emily: config delivery detail: use compact protobuf over the stream so runtime parsing is fast. include a small crc for decision_hash.
tomas: propose deterministic tie-breaker: lane order preserved in profile object; if equal score pick first. document it.
lia: hardware signal integration: if gpu_queue_depth > threshold and latency_slo_violations rising, matrix may prefer lower-bit lane subject to quality budget. but this ties into routing later.
emily: agreed — matrix can emit a "preferred_quality_budget" tag for smart-router to consider.
sam: dev-bot: scheduled canary: quant-matrix-canary -> eng-ml-prod on 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z (JOB#7721).
emily: i'll land a PR with schema, runtime shim, telemetry events, and the canary playbook. comments welcome on the schema or safety boundaries.
tomas: add a small audit log entry per-decision to help postmortem. even just a sampled log to S3 is fine.
lia: tiny nit: ensure rule weights are optional and default to 1.
emily: noted. thanks all.
sam: please include a runbook step: if mirror_delta > threshold for 24h, auto-pause canary and alert ML team.
